purpose: Teach: 洋楽/紅白/表参道/ビーズ/格言/コンテナ/ワゴン/エサ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが洋楽好きで、よく流していらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad really does love Western music — he plays it all the time.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Speaking to herself as much as to Sho. Soft, almost amused. The way a mother notices small habits of people she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、紅白歌合戦見たいな
lines.en: Mom, I want to watch the Kohaku Uta Gassen.
lines.style: Direct, bright request. A child's voice reaching upward. Certain of what he wants but still asking permission. No doubt, just hope.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが表参道のカフェに連れて行ってくださるって
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'd take you to that café in Omotesando.
lines.style: Gentle, understated excitement. Offering good news as a simple fact. Warm beneath the measured delivery. The pleasure of being the messenger.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんからビーズのアクセサリー、いただいたわ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma gave me some beaded accessories.
lines.style: Proud announcement. Voice lifts slightly on the gift itself. A small boy pleased to share something special he's received. Seeking acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの格言、家訓にしようね
lines.en: Sho, let's make your grandfather's words something our family lives by.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful proposal. Speaking with intention but not solemnity. The voice of someone marking something as important. Tender, not heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとコンテナ船を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw the container ships.
lines.style: Eager report. Voice rises with remembered wonder. The pride of having done something with Dad. Wanting her to know what he witnessed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祭りのワゴンで、焼きそば食べましょう
lines.en: Sho, shall we get yakisoba from the festival stand?
lines.style: Gentle invitation. Warm, present attention. The tone of a mother offering small good moments. Unhurried, affectionate.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんちでメダカにエサあげたよ
lines.en: Mom, I fed the killifish at Grandpa's house.
lines.style: Quietly proud achievement. Voice steady and sure. A child reporting something he did well. The satisfaction of having been trusted with a small responsibility.
